definitions.explanation: Describes someone who handles tasks smoothly and efficiently, getting things done quickly and well.

examples.japanese: {手際|てぎわ}のいい⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦ぶり→〜ぶり：28358_buri⟧だ。

⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{店員|てんいん}→店員：00897_tenin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{手際|てぎわ}→手際：06657_tegiwa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}→注文：03485_chuumon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦{出|で}てくる→出てくる：29121_detekuru⟧。
examples.english: That clerk is efficient, so orders come out quickly.

examples.japanese: {手際|てぎわ}よく⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{感心|かんしん}した→感心する：21451_kanshinsuru⟧。
examples.english: I was impressed by how deftly she prepared the meal.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{手際|てぎわ}→手際：06657_tegiwa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧: to be skillful/efficient (predicate)
- {手際|てぎわ}のいい + noun: skillful/efficient ~ (modifier)
- {手際|てぎわ}よく + verb: skillfully, efficiently (adverbial)
- ⟦{手際|てぎわ}→手際：06657_tegiwa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧: to be clumsy, inefficient (opposite)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {手際|てぎわ}のいい⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧: efficient work
- {手際|てぎわ}よく⟦{片付|かたづ}ける→片付ける：01192_katazukeru⟧: to tidy up efficiently
- {手際|てぎわ}よく⟦{進|すす}める→進める：01949_susumeru⟧: to proceed efficiently

USAGE: ⟦{手際|てぎわ}→手際：06657_tegiwa⟧ (literally 'hand situation') refers to the skill and efficiency with which someone handles tasks. It is most often used in positive constructions (⟦{手際|てぎわ}→手際：06657_tegiwa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧), but ⟦{手際|てぎわ}→手際：06657_tegiwa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧ (clumsy, slow) is also common.
